cands.bio: Democratic candidate for Alabama House District 4 in 2026. Small technology business owner in Madison, Alabama, with an M.S. in Management Information Systems from UAH. Former UAH Alumni Association board member and former second vice-president of the NAACP Limestone County Unit. Has not held public office.

endorsements.text: Alabama AFL-CIO, 314 Action Fund, Everytown for Gun Safety Action Fund and the Alabama Democratic County Chairs' Association, as listed by the candidate in his Ballotpedia survey.

cands.gaps: His birthplace, where he grew up and the year he first came to Alabama were not found. No record of public office or a government work history turned up. The candidate's Ballotpedia survey answer on responsible growth and energy policy was cut off, and so was his campaign website page, so some positions may be missing. We found no documented actions on any issue, only stated positions. No news coverage of controversies or foreign ties turned up in the pages reviewed.

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 4 since 2018, first elected in a 2018 special election. Worked as a north Alabama marketing representative for Encore Rehabilitation. Vice-Chair of the Fiscal Responsibility Committee in 2023-2026.
cands.gaps: We could not find his upbringing or when he came to Alabama. We found no sponsored bills with their content, and no statements or actions on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for 2026. We found no public controversies, foreign ties or land-use stances. His education and career dates are also missing.
